newsitem.title: USA: Cygne Designs vice chairman to resign.
newsitem.headline: Cygne Designs vice chairman to resign.

text.p: Cygne Designs Inc said Wednesday that Irving Benson will resign as president and vice chairman effective November 29.
Benson, who founded Cygne Designs in 1975, plans to form a consulting company that will provide services to Cygne Designs for design, development and merchandising matters and special projects.
Benson also will continue to serve on the company's board.
Cygne Designs, which is a private label designer and manufacturer of woven and knit career and casual clothing for women, was not immediately available to comment on Benson's replacement.
